title: Practice: Advantages and Limitations of Swift
prompt: Which approach is the best starting point for advantages and limitations of swift?
objective: Apply the ideas from Advantages and Limitations of Swift in a small learning task.

options: Put unrelated logic in one expression and skip naming or tests.
Use a minimal Swift example for advantages and limitations of swift, then verify its behavior and a relevant edge case.
Rely only on a screenshot without inspecting source or results.
Assume the compiler and runtime will infer the intended behavior without checking it.

expected_output: Practise: Advantages and Limitations of Swift
acceptance_criteria: Apply the rule for safety and developer productivity.
Include the required minimum evidence in the submitted answer.
Explain or locally verify the result and one edge case.
hints: Begin with safety and developer productivity; avoid writing the entire feature at once.
Use the expected result to decide what to inspect next.
A correct source-string check is only a minimum criterion; still compile and test the example locally.

grading_config.correct_answer: Use a minimal Swift example for advantages and limitations of swift, then verify its behavior and a relevant edge case.

grading_method: Server-side supported source-string or choice grader for the basic check; this is not a sandboxed Swift compiler. Compile and run locally for actual correctness.
retry_policy: Allow retries. Incorrect submissions award no XP; the backend remains responsible for one-time reward idempotency.
status_note: The reference answer stays in the protected content repository; public exercise endpoints must not return solution files.
